reason: I'd sign up for the free plan and poke at it because I try every new AI tool, but I already have a chatbot and I only keep about one in ten. A cute mascot doesn't solve a problem I'd pay for within a month.
objection: I already have a chatbot, so why add or switch? A mascot is a skin on something I can already do, and I don't see what it adds that moves signups or support numbers.
would_change_my_mind: Proof, with real numbers from a similar SaaS, that the mascot lifts onboarding or trial conversion over a plain chat widget, plus on-site actions that work on my app without custom engineering during the trial.
